target: Isolation of the two-qutrit 2-unitary set among dual and T-dual unitaries (AME review question T7, d=3)

statement.objects: U(9)=two-qutrit unitaries on C^3⊗C^3; realignment U^R and partial transpose U^Γ as defined in the source; dual-unitary means U and U^R unitary; T-dual means U and U^Γ unitary.
statement.O9: The set U9={(v1⊗v2)P9(v3⊗v4): vi∈U(3)} of all 2-unitaries of order 9, per the source uniqueness statement [44].
statement.primary_target: Decide whether O9 is isolated in the dual-unitary set D and in the T-dual set T: does there exist epsilon>0 such that every U in D (resp. T) within operator/Frobenius distance epsilon of O9 lies in O9? A positive isolation proof answers the d=3 part of T7 negatively for non-2-unitary gates; an explicit family of non-2-unitary dual/T-dual gates converging to O9 answers it positively.
statement.corollary_if_isolated: Rigorous existence of a qualitative entangling-power gap: sup{e_p(U): U dual-unitary (resp. T-dual), U not 2-unitary} < 1, using compactness, continuity of e_p and the source statement that e_p=1 exactly on 2-unitaries. No explicit gap value is claimed unless separately certified.

primary_attestation.source: Rajchel-Mieldzioć, Bistroń, Rico, Lakshminarayan, Życzkowski, arXiv:2508.04777v3 (25 Jun 2026)
quotes: (T7). Are there dual/T-dual gates in U(9) arbitrarily close to the 2-unitary permutation matrix P9 related to the state AME(4,3)?
U9 seems to be isolated in the set of dual or T-dual unitaries. This is visually seen as a gap in the ep(U)−gt(U) plot
the region of the gap, the rigorous existence of which is yet to be established.
every 2-unitary on H3⊗H3 has the form U9 = (v1⊗v2)P9(v3⊗v4)
primary_attestation.location: layout text lines 538–578 (uniqueness and gap) and 1399–1405 (T7); parent read both passages
primary_attestation.interpretation_guard: Literal T7 is trivially yes through local-unitary images of P9, which are 2-unitary and hence dual/T-dual. The non-trivial target is non-2-unitary gates near the 2-unitary set, matching the source’s isolation/gap wording; report both readings explicitly.

baseline: Source: isolation appears numerically and the gap is not rigorously established; Us(2π/3) has e_p=15/16 and is conjectured best but not proved. d=4 has continuous families reaching 2-unitaries per source ref.[62]. Uniqueness of order-9 2-unitaries is imported from source ref.[44] and must be read before use.
proposed_representation: Exact real-coordinate linearization at P9 of both unitarity constraints; compare kernel dimension with the tangent dimension of the LU orbit; if equal, use implicit-function/constant-rank plus invariance and compactness for the full orbit. Untrusted scout lead: kernel and orbit tangent are both 33 via the perfect tetracode. Exact P9 and all source conventions must be re-derived first.
acceptance: Complete written proof covering BOTH dual and T-dual statements, exact rational rank certificates from two independent implementations (or exact rational elimination plus independent recomputation), positive/negative controls (d=4 P16 known continuous family must not be called isolated; local-unitary tangent controls; wrong-reshuffling mutation must change ranks), parent re-derivation and Claude hostile review, then priority audit. Floating rank estimates alone are insufficient.
continuation: Only after d=3 closes: explicit epsilon/gap bound, or T7 analogues for d=5/7 permutation 2-unitaries.
